propositions: When a guardrail or content-policy block occurs (finish_reason=content_filter), the operator-facing message incorrectly reports 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the real cause (a guardrail or model refusal).
The resolution_class CHANGE_INPUT is correctly assigned to content-filter denials but message_for() returns a generic message misattributing the block to input size or format issues.
The message_for() function needs an optional finish_reason parameter to disambiguate content-filter blocks and return an accurate message naming the guardrail/policy block.
Three call sites (llm_commands.py, close_precheck.py, and diagnostic rendering) must thread finish_reason into message_for() to enable the fix.
Existing CHANGE_INPUT messages for genuine size/malformed cases (413, context-length errors) must remain unchanged to preserve backward compatibility.
